name: Mia Gobble
headline: Producer & Generalist Developer
about:
Since I was 10 years old I have had an undying passion for game development across multiple disciplines. I've always had my eyes set on the full picture of projects; I conceptualize, produce, release, and maintain games with the vision of making truly great games that people care about.

I've had excellent opportunities during my career so far, previously running a very successful studio (Iconic Gaming), and now starting up a new one (Oxomo Games). I've also worked for massive projects with billions of play sessions and up to hundreds of thousands of concurrent players. My own projects kept loyal playerbases for years!

My employers have always recognized my strengths: pragmatic leadership and development that knows how to stick to roadmaps and deadlines. That being said, I would consider myself excellent at taking calculated risks to make mechanically and stylistically unique projects that feel fresh to newly discovered audiences.

I'm always on the lookout for new opportunities! If you want to chat about employment or partnership opportunities, feel free to reach out to me via e-mail or Discord. You can learn more about me on my website (igottic.com), where I break down the best projects I've been a part of, and what I do.

experience.title: Talent Manager & Lead Developer
experience.description: I now handle talent management at Tencell Studios in addition to my development work. Some of my new responsibilities include talent outreach, interview processing, skillset evaluation, and more.

experience.title: Producer & Lead Developer
experience.description:
I used to work on Slap Battles! I took on a variety of roles, including project management, data analysis, game design, generalist development, and scrum leadership. During my time, I helped the game reach a peak of 149k concurrent users. Under my leadership, I directly increased engagement, retention, and revenue, all while keeping the community satisfied.

I loved working at Slap Battles because it allowed me to be autonomous over design and execution, which gave me room to throw darts at the board and see what sticks. With both my production and development, I had the opportunity to ship multiple major features, content updates, and more, all by myself or alongside the team.

I am now working on a new project under this company. Stay tuned!

experience.title: Generalist Developer
experience.description: Prior to being a producer and lead developer, I was a generalist development contractor, working on critical reworks to Slap Battles.

experience.title: Producer & CEO
experience.description:
Oxomo Games is a brand new studio created by me, aiming to take risks with game design and discover new audiences on Roblox. My time here is spent producing and generalizing, ensuring we get high-quality games released. We're excited to soon release Velocity and Deep Depths.

This studio is my opportunity to try design ideas and workflows before I apply a similar philosophy to my main line of work. I love to try new ideas, and even if something flops, it gives me something to learn from.

experience.title: Research Panelist
experience.description: I am a part of Meta's AR/VR Research Panel. During my time here so far, I have actively tested new AR/VR products geared towards developers of the Horzion Worlds platform, leaving critical feedback about workflows and design decisions. My work here was extremely opinionated, but my thoughts were worked into iterations on the platform.

experience.title: Producer & CEO
experience.description:
Iconic Gaming is a studio I founded that focused on pushing creative online games on the Roblox platform. As of April 2025, I have handed off the CEO position to another leader to pursue new opportunities, and since then the studio has shut down.

During my time at Iconic Gaming, I created back-to-back projects that succeeded, often times peaking at 2k-12k CCU. I handled production, lead development, hiring management, and more, and employed many people under me.

This experience solidified my role as a professional on the platform and helped me learn a lot of what I know now, and without this studio I would not be where I am now. My new studio, Oxomo Games, uses experience (usually from mistakes) to execute development on new projects.

experience.title: Event Organizer
experience.description: I previously created developer-oriented educational events on the Roblox platform. These events aimed to be engaging, memorable, and valuable. Events I held related to Roblox game development, and aimed to help new developers get their feet off the ground. Unfortunately Roblox didn't do much with the events platform, so as such, I decided to step down.

experience.title: Freelance Generalist Developer
experience.description: Since 2014 and until mid 2024, I did freelance generalist development work on the Roblox platform. During this time I had taken short-term work with companies like Swenzje Games, Outstanding Move, and Level Up Gaming. I contributed to many projects on the platform with a variety of work.

experience.title: Accelerator Program Member
experience.description: Iconic Gaming was being funded and guided by the Roforco Accelerator program as a part of YCombinator 22. The funded project was a Roblox game that aimed to take a twist on the disaster genre. The game was under Iconic Gaming, named "Disaster Masters", and was a one-against-all game where one person destroyed the world and players while the rest survived. I was also a community partner for Roforco before it started, giving insight and tips for running the business.

experience.title: Programmer
experience.description: I worked on an untitled upcoming FPS game on Roblox simply named "Games Unite Testing Place". I was responsible for making an additive animation system and rigid body physics system.
